question: Which of the following country other than India has Field Hockey as its National Sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While India is widely known for its passion for field hockey, Pakistan also shares this deep-rooted love for the sport.
 
• Historical Significance: Field hockey has a rich history in both countries, dating back to British colonial times.
